# vibeoncall_schedule (Data Source)

Looks up a schedule by name, for example to page one that Terraform does not manage from `vibeoncall_escalation_policy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vibeoncall_schedule" "platform" {
  name    = "Platform primary"
  team_id = data.vibeoncall_team.platform.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Schedule name. Matched exactly.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) Numeric ID of a team that owns the schedule. Narrows the search to that team's schedules.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric schedule ID.
- `rotations` (Attributes List) Rotations in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rotations))
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Numeric IDs of the owning teams. Null for a global schedule.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of the schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--rotations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rotations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric rotation ID.
- `name` (String) Rotation name.
